title: Admin User Authentication & Role-Based Access
businessObjective: To enable secure access for Human Resources Administrators to manage personnel records and system settings.
preconditions: The administrator must have valid login credentials.

mainFlow.expected: User is authenticated and redirected to the Dashboard page.

alternateFlows.name: Empty Fields
steps: Leave username and password fields empty
Display inline validation messages 'Required' for both fields

alternateFlows.name: Forgot Password
steps: Navigate to the password reset request screen

dataRequirements.rules: Must be a valid email format.
Must meet security requirements (minimum length, special characters).

acceptanceCriteria: Valid username and password should authenticate successfully and redirect to the Dashboard page.
Invalid username or password should display an error alert "Invalid credentials" without revealing which field was incorrect.
Submitting empty username or password fields should display inline validation messages "Required".
Clicking "Forgot your password?" should navigate to the password reset request screen.
nonFunctionalRequirements: The login process should be completed within 2 seconds.
The system should ensure data encryption during transmission.
